blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Savi Davison led PLDT’s bounce back with 21 points against the also-ran Galeries Tower, 25-13, 25-23, 23-25, 25-18, to stay in semifinal contention in the 2026 PVL All-Filipino Conference Saklab Series on Saturday at Philsports Arena. After the High Speed Hitters’ five-set meltdown to Farm Fresh earlier this week, Davison came out firing with 18 kills, two blocks, and an ace, while also tallying 16 excellent receptions as they improved to 4-3, tied with Choco Mucho at No.4. “It really comes down to every point, so we just wanted to emphasize every point, every set, which turned into […]...
